prompt_parts.text: For y = (x − 3)² − 4, find the vertex, the axis of symmetry, the range, the x-intercepts and the y-intercept.

worked_solution: Vertex form y = a(x − p)² + q has vertex (p, q), so the vertex is (3, −4) and the axis is x = 3.
a = 1 > 0, so the parabola opens up and the minimum value is −4. Range: y ≥ −4.
x-intercepts: set y = 0, so (x − 3)² = 4 and x − 3 = ±2, giving x = 5 or x = 1.
final_answer: Vertex (3, −4); axis x = 3; range y ≥ −4; x-intercepts 1, 5; y-intercept 5

final_answer: Vertex (−1, 8), maximum 8; range y ≤ 8; x-intercepts −3, 1; y-intercept 6

worked_solution: Label the first point P, the second point Q (40 m closer) and the top of the tower T.
At Q the interior angle PQT is 180° − 45° = 135°, so ∠PTQ = 180° − 30° − 135° = 15°.
Sine law in triangle PQT: QT / sin 30° = PQ / sin 15°, so QT = 40 sin 30° / sin 15° ≈ 77.3 m.
In the right triangle at Q, height = QT sin 45° ≈ 77.3 · 0.7071 ≈ 54.6 m.
